senses.en: a small line on the skin, often from age
a small fold or line in paper or cloth
to make small lines or folds in something

ex.en: My grandmother has kind eyes and a few gentle wrinkles.
ex.zh: 我奶奶有慈祥的眼睛和几道柔和的皱纹。

ex.en: If you leave the shirt in the bag, it will get badly wrinkled before the interview.
ex.zh: 如果你把衬衫留在包里，面试前它会皱得很厉害。

tip: wrinkle 作名词多指皮肤皱纹；衣物褶皱也常用，作动词是“使起皱”。

senses.en: a room used for keeping supplies or unused things

ex.en: The spare chairs are stacked neatly in the storeroom.
ex.zh: 备用椅子整齐地堆放在储藏室里。

ex.en: Schools should keep emergency supplies in a secure storeroom that staff can access quickly when necessary.
ex.zh: 学校应将应急物资存放在安全的储藏室里，确保教职员工在必要时能够迅速取用。

col: keep something in a storeroom｜把某物存放在储藏室
tip: storeroom是房间；warehouse通常指较大的仓库。

senses.en: free someone or something from an unwanted thing

ex.en: We finally got rid of the broken garden chairs.
ex.zh: 我们终于处理掉了那些坏掉的花园椅子。

ex.en: Cities can rid their streets of excessive litter by improving waste collection and encouraging responsible behaviour.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过改进垃圾收集并鼓励负责任的行为，清除街道上过多的垃圾。

col: rid something of｜清除某物中的
tip: 牢记get rid of；rid A of B表示清除A中的B。

senses.en: Relating to the region around the South Pole.
The region surrounding the South Pole, including Antarctica.

ex.en: We watched a film about penguins on Antarctic ice.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于南极冰面上企鹅的影片。

ex.en: Scientists monitor Antarctic ice to understand how rising global temperatures affect sea levels worldwide.
ex.zh: 科学家监测南极冰层，以了解全球气温升高如何影响世界各地的海平面。

tip: 名词用the Antarctic；Antarctica专指南极洲。
note: 首字母已改为标准大写：Antarctic。

senses.en: country where you were born; homeland

ex.en: Many students return to their motherland after studying abroad.
ex.zh: 许多学生在国外学习后回到祖国。

ex.en: The song expresses deep love for the motherland and its people.
ex.zh: 这首歌表达了对祖国和人民的深厚热爱。

col: love for the motherland｜对祖国的爱
return to one's motherland｜回到祖国
tip: motherland指祖国，常带感情色彩；fatherland也指祖国，多用于德国等。

senses.en: a movement of the body to express an idea or feeling
to make a movement with your hands or head

ex.en: He made a gesture with his hand to ask us to be quiet.
ex.zh: 他用手势示意我们安静。

ex.en: Giving a small gift is a kind gesture to show thanks to a teacher.
ex.zh: 送一份小礼物是向老师表示感谢的善意举动。

tip: gesture既可作名词也可作动词；作名词时常用搭配make a gesture。

senses.en: Used to confirm something or emphasize that it is true.
Used to add information that strengthens a previous statement.

ex.en: The soup was very tasty indeed, so I had more.
ex.zh: 这汤确实非常好喝，所以我又喝了一些。

ex.en: Public transport can reduce congestion; indeed, reliable bus services may persuade many commuters to stop driving.
ex.zh: 公共交通能够缓解拥堵；事实上，可靠的公交服务可能使许多通勤者放弃开车。

col: very useful indeed｜确实非常有用
tip: 可用very＋形容词＋indeed加强语气。

senses.en: a machine that plays music from CDs or tapes, with two speakers
used to describe sound that comes from two speakers

ex.en: He turned on the stereo and played his favourite song.
ex.zh: 他打开音响，播放他最喜欢的歌。

ex.en: The new stereo system in the living room produces clear and powerful sound.
ex.zh: 客厅里新的立体声音响系统发出清晰而有力的声音。

tip: 作名词指音响设备；作形容词常置于名词前，如stereo sound。

senses.en: to work out a number or amount using mathematics
to guess or plan something based on facts

ex.en: Can you calculate how much water the family uses each week?
ex.zh: 你能算出一家人每周用多少水吗？

ex.en: Students calculated the cost of the school trip and found a cheaper way to travel.
ex.zh: 学生们 calcularj 了学校旅行的费用，并找到一种更便宜的出行方式。

col: be calculated to do｜被设计用以做
tip: calculate 后常接 how much / that 从句；与 count（数数）区分。

senses.en: the way someone feels or acts because of something
a chemical change when substances combine

ex.en: Her reaction to the news was calm and thoughtful.
ex.zh: 她对这个消息的反应平静而深思熟虑。

ex.en: When the experiment produced a strong chemical reaction, the students carefully wrote down every change they saw.
ex.zh: 当实验产生强烈的化学反应时，学生们仔细记下他们看到的每一个变化。

tip: 搭配 reaction to sth，表示“对某事的反应”，用 to 不用 for。

senses.en: not wearing anything on your feet
with nothing on your feet

ex.en: The children ran barefoot across the warm sand.
ex.zh: 孩子们赤脚跑过温暖的沙滩。

ex.en: Walking barefoot on grass can be relaxing, but check for sharp stones first.
ex.zh: 赤脚走在草地上会很放松，但先要检查有没有尖石头。

tip: 形容词和副词同形：go barefoot（赤脚走），不加-ly。

senses.en: a road that goes around a city

ex.en: They built a new ring-road to reduce traffic in the city centre.
ex.zh: 他们建了一条新环路来减少市中心的交通。

ex.en: Living near the ring-road means you can drive around the city without going through the busy centre.
ex.zh: 住在环路附近意味着你可以绕过繁忙的市中心开车。

tip: 英式英语常用 ring road（可无连字符），美式多用 beltway。

senses.en: an area of a country or the world
a particular area of the body

ex.en: This region is famous for its apples and cheese.
ex.zh: 这个地区以苹果和奶酪闻名。

ex.en: Improved transport links could attract more businesses to the region and create jobs for local residents.
ex.zh: 改善交通联系可以吸引更多企业进入该地区，并为当地居民创造就业机会。

tip: in the region of接金额等，表示“大约”。

senses.en: air moving into or out of your lungs
one act of taking air into your lungs

ex.en: Her breath formed a cloud in the cold air.
ex.zh: 她呼出的气在冷空气中形成了一团白雾。

ex.en: Taking a slow, deep breath can help students manage anxiety before an important examination.
ex.zh: 缓慢地深呼吸一次，有助于学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。

col: take a deep breath｜深吸一口气
out of breath｜上气不接下气
tip: breath是名词；breathe是动词，末尾读/ð/。

senses.en: a building made mostly of glass for growing plants

ex.en: The gardeners grow tomatoes in the glasshouse during winter.
ex.zh: 园丁们在冬天于温室里种植西红柿。

ex.en: Our school built a glasshouse so students can study plant growth all year round.
ex.zh: 我们学校建了一个温室，这样学生可以全年研究植物生长。

tip: glasshouse与greenhouse同义，但greenhouse更常用；注意glasshouse有时也指“监狱”俚语。

senses.en: previously owned or used by someone else
learned from others rather than through direct experience
from a previous owner, or through another person's account

ex.en: My second-hand bicycle still rides smoothly after years of use.
ex.zh: 我的二手自行车用了多年，骑起来仍很顺畅。

ex.en: Buying second-hand furniture can reduce household spending and prevent usable goods from ending up in landfill.
ex.zh: 购买二手家具能减少家庭开支，并避免尚可使用的物品最终被填埋。

tip: 既可指物品用过，也可指信息并非亲身获得。

senses.en: a teacher who guides individuals or small groups
to teach someone individually or in a small group

ex.en: My tutor helped me understand fractions using paper circles.
ex.zh: 我的辅导老师用圆形纸片帮我理解了分数。

ex.en: A personal tutor can help students develop effective study habits and address specific learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 私人教师可以帮助学生养成有效的学习习惯，并解决具体的学习困难。

col: tutor someone in maths｜辅导某人数学
tip: tutor强调个别或小组辅导，不一定是教授。

senses.en: A condition causing illness after contact with a normally harmless substance

ex.en: My brother has an allergy to peanuts and walnuts.
ex.zh: 我哥哥对花生和核桃过敏。

ex.en: Schools should have clear procedures for helping children who experience a severe food allergy reaction.
ex.zh: 学校应制定明确流程，为出现严重食物过敏反应的儿童提供帮助。

tip: 常用have an allergy to；to后接引起过敏的物质。

senses.en: A boat carrying passengers or vehicles across water regularly.
To carry people or goods between places, often repeatedly.

ex.en: We took the ferry across the lake this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我们乘渡船穿过了湖。

ex.en: Reliable ferry services connect island communities with mainland hospitals, schools, and employment opportunities throughout the year.
ex.zh: 可靠的轮渡服务全年将岛屿社区与大陆的医院、学校和就业机会连接起来。

tip: 复数为ferries；动词也可指用车反复接送。

senses.en: the condition of someone or something at a particular time
a country, its government, or a region within a country
to express something clearly in speech or writing

ex.en: The kitchen was in a terrible state after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，厨房一片狼藉。

ex.en: The report states that reliable public transport is essential for reducing dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 报告指出，可靠的公共交通对于减少对私家车的依赖至关重要。

col: in a good state｜处于良好状态
tip: state作动词较正式，可接that从句；名词可指状态或国家。

senses.en: an area of short grass around a house or in a park

ex.en: My father cuts the lawn every Saturday morning in summer.
ex.zh: 夏天我父亲每周六上午修剪草坪。

ex.en: The school keeps a large green lawn where students can relax after lunch.
ex.zh: 学校保留着一大片绿草坪，学生午饭后可以在那里放松。

tip: lawn 指人工修剪的草地；野外大片草地用 grassland 或 meadow。

senses.en: a wide road for fast traffic, often without tolls

ex.en: We took the freeway to avoid the busy city centre.
ex.zh: 我们走高速公路以避开繁忙的市中心。

ex.en: The new freeway will make it easier for people to travel between the two cities.
ex.zh: 新的高速公路将使人们在这两个城市之间出行更加方便。

col: on the freeway｜在高速公路上
get on the freeway｜上高速公路
tip: freeway 多用于美式英语；英式常说 motorway。

senses.en: a vertical arrangement of items or a printed page section
a regular newspaper or magazine feature on a particular subject
a tall upright structure, often supporting a roof

ex.en: Put the prices in the column beside each item.
ex.zh: 把价格填在每件商品旁边的那一列里。

ex.en: The newspaper's weekly science column helps readers understand how new discoveries may affect everyday life.
ex.zh: 这家报纸每周的科学专栏帮助读者了解新发现可能如何影响日常生活。

col: a column of figures｜一列数字
tip: column 是竖列，row 是横行；词尾 n 不发音。

senses.en: Help someone remember something they need to do or know
Make someone think of a similar person, thing, or experience

ex.en: Please remind me to take my umbrella before we leave.
ex.zh: 出门前请提醒我带伞。

ex.en: Schools should regularly remind students to protect their personal information when using online learning platforms.
ex.zh: 学校应定期提醒学生，在使用在线学习平台时保护个人信息。

col: remind someone to do something｜提醒某人做某事
remind someone of something｜使某人想起某事
tip: 提醒去做用remind sb to do；使想起用of。

senses.en: to encourage something to develop or become more widely accepted
to give someone a higher position at work
to attract attention to something to increase interest or sales

ex.en: Our local club promotes cycling through free weekend rides.
ex.zh: 我们当地的俱乐部通过免费的周末骑行活动推广骑车。

ex.en: Schools can promote healthier lifestyles by providing nutritious meals and encouraging students to take regular exercise.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过提供营养餐并鼓励学生定期锻炼来倡导更健康的生活方式。

col: promote economic growth｜促进经济增长
be promoted to manager｜获晋升为经理
tip: 晋升到某职位用be promoted to＋职位。

senses.en: A large group of musicians playing different instruments together.

ex.en: The orchestra began playing as the lights dimmed.
ex.zh: 灯光暗下来时，管弦乐队开始演奏。

ex.en: Public funding helps the local orchestra offer affordable concerts and introduce classical music to younger audiences.
ex.zh: 公共资助帮助当地管弦乐队举办票价亲民的音乐会，并向年轻观众介绍古典音乐。

col: conduct an orchestra｜指挥管弦乐队
play in an orchestra｜在管弦乐队演奏
tip: 指整个乐队；成员通常演奏弦乐、管乐及打击乐器。

senses.en: Relating to the body rather than the mind.
Existing as something real that can be touched or measured.
Relating to natural forces, matter, and energy.

ex.en: Gardening gives me plenty of physical exercise every weekend.
ex.zh: 每个周末做园艺活都让我得到充分的身体锻炼。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can improve public health and reduce the financial pressure on national healthcare systems.
ex.zh: 规律的体育活动能够改善公众健康，并减轻国家医疗体系的财政压力。

tip: physical偏身体或物质；physiological指生理的。

senses.en: A hollow tube that carries liquid or gas.
To carry liquid or gas through pipes.
A small bowl with a tube used for smoking tobacco.

ex.en: Water dripped from a broken pipe under the sink.
ex.zh: 水从洗涤槽下面一根破裂的管子里滴下来。

ex.en: Replacing damaged water pipes can help cities conserve resources and ensure a reliable supply of clean drinking water.
ex.zh: 更换受损水管可以帮助城市节约资源，并确保清洁饮用水的可靠供应。

col: pipe water to｜用管道把水输送到
tip: pipe可作动词：pipe water to把水输送到某处。

senses.en: the quality of always telling the truth
the habit of saying what you really think

ex.en: Her honesty about the mistake won everyone's respect.
ex.zh: 她坦白承认错误，赢得了大家的尊重。

ex.en: Honesty is the most important rule in scientific research, because false data harm everyone.
ex.zh: 诚信是科学研究中最重要的一条规则，因为虚假数据会伤害所有人。

tip: 不可数，不说an honesty；常见句式Honesty is the best policy。

senses.en: one thousand million
an extremely large quantity, usually expressed as billions

ex.en: The science museum displayed a rock a billion years old.
ex.zh: 科学博物馆展出了一块有十亿年历史的岩石。

ex.en: Governments spend billions of dollars on transport infrastructure to support economic growth and connect isolated communities.
ex.zh: 各国政府投入数十亿美元建设交通基础设施，以促进经济增长并连接偏远社区。

tip: 具体数值后不加s；泛指数十亿用billions of。

senses.en: Related to medicine or the treatment of illness.
An examination to check a person's health.

ex.en: The hotel called for medical help when a guest fainted.
ex.zh: 一位客人晕倒后，酒店呼叫了医疗救助。

ex.en: Governments should improve access to medical services in rural areas where hospitals are often far away.
ex.zh: 政府应改善农村地区的医疗服务可及性，因为那里的医院往往距离很远。

tip: medical作名词多用于英式英语，指体检，不指医生。

senses.en: Long narrow bands differing in colour from the surrounding surface

ex.en: My favourite shirt has blue stripes across the front.
ex.zh: 我最喜欢的衬衫正面有蓝色条纹。

ex.en: Researchers investigate how zebra stripes may discourage biting insects, potentially revealing useful strategies for protecting livestock.
ex.zh: 研究人员探究斑马条纹如何阻止叮咬昆虫，这可能为保护牲畜提供有用策略。

col: black and white stripes｜黑白条纹
tip: stripes是stripe的复数；“条纹的”用striped。

senses.en: someone who prepares written material or manages a publication
someone who selects and arranges recorded images or sound
software used to change digital content

ex.en: The editor suggested a clearer ending for my story.
ex.zh: 编辑建议我给故事写一个更清楚的结尾。

ex.en: A newspaper editor must balance the public's right to information with respect for individual privacy.
ex.zh: 报纸编辑必须在公众知情权与尊重个人隐私之间取得平衡。

col: editor of a magazine｜杂志编辑
tip: editor可指编辑人员，也可指编辑软件。

senses.en: Something made by combining two or more different things.

ex.en: Stir the mixture until it becomes smooth and creamy.
ex.zh: 搅拌混合物，直到它变得顺滑绵密。

ex.en: Successful cities offer a mixture of affordable housing, reliable transport, and accessible public spaces.
ex.zh: 成功的城市兼具可负担的住房、可靠的交通和方便使用的公共空间。

tip: a mixture of 后可接物质，也可接情感等抽象事物。

senses.en: To make something happen later than expected or planned.
A period of waiting before something happens or continues.

ex.en: Heavy snow delayed our flight until the next morning.
ex.zh: 大雪使我们的航班延误到第二天早上。

ex.en: Delays in public transport can reduce productivity and discourage people from leaving their cars at home.
ex.zh: 公共交通的延误会降低生产效率，并使人们不愿放弃开车出行。

tip: 动词后接动名词：delay doing，不用to do。

senses.en: The sound or action of laughing

ex.en: Laughter filled the kitchen when the puppy sneezed.
ex.zh: 小狗一打喷嚏，厨房里便充满了笑声。

ex.en: Shared laughter can strengthen social bonds and help people manage stress in demanding work environments.
ex.zh: 一起欢笑可以增进人际联系，帮助人们应对高压工作环境中的压力。

col: a burst of laughter｜一阵笑声
tip: laughter不可数；表示“一阵笑声”用a burst of laughter。

senses.en: a boat that carries people across water

ex.en: We took a small ferryboat to the island near the coast.
ex.zh: 我们坐一艘小渡船去了海岸附近的岛。

ex.en: The old ferryboat carries students across the river every morning before school starts.
ex.zh: 每天早上上学前，那艘旧渡船载着学生过河。

tip: ferryboat 就是 ferry，常可互换，口语里多用 ferry。

senses.en: To remove hair from skin using a razor.
To remove thin pieces or reduce something by a small amount.
An act of removing facial hair with a razor.

ex.en: I shave every morning before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 我每天早晨出门上班前都会刮胡子。

ex.en: Improved transport connections could shave several minutes off daily journeys and encourage more people to commute by train.
ex.zh: 改善交通衔接可以缩短几分钟的日常行程，并鼓励更多人乘火车通勤。

tip: 过去式shaved；过去分词shaved或shaven。

senses.en: To become curved or make something curved.
To move your body downwards or forwards from the waist.
A curved section of a road, river, or other long object.

ex.en: Bend the wire gently to make a small hook.
ex.zh: 轻轻弯曲铁丝，做成一个小钩子。

ex.en: Drivers should reduce their speed before approaching a sharp bend, especially when road conditions are poor.
ex.zh: 驾驶员在接近急弯前应减速，尤其是在路况不佳时。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为bent；bend down表示弯下腰。

senses.en: a young sheep
meat from a young sheep, eaten as food

ex.en: A small lamb followed its mother across the field.
ex.zh: 一只小羊跟着妈妈穿过田野。

ex.en: Producing lamb requires land and water, so its environmental impact should be considered when planning sustainable diets.
ex.zh: 生产羊羔肉需要土地和水，因此规划可持续饮食时应考虑其环境影响。

tip: 词尾b不发音；指小羊可数，指肉不可数。

senses.en: Pleasure and satisfaction in achievements, qualities, or people you value.
Respect for yourself, sometimes involving an exaggerated sense of importance.
To feel especially pleased about your own qualities or achievements.

ex.en: Her face shone with pride as she displayed her painting.
ex.zh: 她展示画作时，脸上洋溢着自豪。

ex.en: Schools can foster community pride by encouraging students to participate in projects that improve their local environment.
ex.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生参与改善当地环境的项目，从而培养社区自豪感。

col: hurt someone's pride｜伤害某人的自尊
pride yourself on｜以自身的……为傲
tip: 动词用pride oneself on；形容词用proud of。

senses.en: female teacher in charge of a school

ex.en: The headmistress greeted every student at the school gate.
ex.zh: 女校长在校门口向每位学生问好。

ex.en: Our headmistress announced that the school would start a new reading program next month.
ex.zh: 我们的女校长宣布学校下个月将启动一个新的阅读项目。

tip: 多用于英式英语；美式常用principal。

senses.en: a soft hat, often with a stiff front part
a cover fitted over the end or opening of something
to set a maximum amount or level for something

ex.en: He pulled on his cap before leaving for practice.
ex.zh: 他戴上帽子后出门去训练。

ex.en: Governments could cap annual rent increases to protect households from sudden rises in housing costs.
ex.zh: 政府可以限制年度租金涨幅，以保护家庭免受住房成本骤增的影响。

col: a cap on fees｜费用上限
tip: cap作动词指设上限；a cap on后接受限项目。

senses.en: in a way that shows good manners

ex.en: He politely asked the teacher for more time to finish the project.
ex.zh: 他礼貌地请求老师多给些时间完成项目。

ex.en: When you disagree with others, it is important to express your opinion politely and clearly.
ex.zh: 当你不同意别人时，礼貌而清楚地表达自己的观点很重要。

tip: politely 是副词，修饰动词，如 politely decline。

senses.en: An event causing great damage, suffering, or loss.
Something that goes extremely badly or fails completely.

ex.en: Dinner was a disaster because I burned the rice.
ex.zh: 晚餐糟透了，因为我把米饭烧焦了。

ex.en: Effective early warning systems can reduce the damage caused by natural disasters and help communities recover more quickly.
ex.zh: 有效的预警系统可以减少自然灾害造成的损失，并帮助社区更快恢复。

tip: 也可夸张形容失败：The party was a disaster。

senses.en: A juicy fruit with fuzzy skin and a large hard stone
Having a pale pinkish orange colour

ex.en: She sliced a ripe peach into her breakfast bowl.
ex.zh: 她把一个熟桃切成片，放进早餐碗里。

ex.en: Peach growers may face reduced harvests when unusually warm winters disrupt the trees' natural flowering cycle.
ex.zh: 冬季异常温暖会扰乱桃树的自然开花周期，桃农可能因此面临减产。

tip: 桃核英式常说 stone，美式常说 pit。

senses.en: someone who enters a building illegally to steal things

ex.en: A burglar climbed through the window while everyone was away.
ex.zh: 大家都不在家时，一名窃贼爬窗而入。

ex.en: Improved street lighting and secure doors may discourage burglars from targeting homes in residential areas.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明并安装牢固的门，可能使窃贼不敢对住宅区的房屋下手。

col: catch a burglar｜抓住入室盗贼
tip: burglar指入室盗贼；robber通常指使用威胁的劫匪。

senses.en: A person who sends a message, letter or package.

ex.en: The sender wrapped the parcel carefully before posting it.
ex.zh: 寄件人在邮寄前仔细包好了包裹。

ex.en: Email users should verify the sender before opening attachments to reduce the risk of digital fraud.
ex.zh: 电子邮件用户应在打开附件前核实发件人，以降低网络诈骗的风险。

tip: sender是发送者，recipient是接收者。

senses.en: to break open suddenly, or to start doing something suddenly
a sudden short explosion or short period of a strong feeling

ex.en: The old water pipe burst and flooded the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 旧水管爆裂了，淹了厨房的地板。

ex.en: When the team scored, the whole crowd burst into cheers and waved their flags.
ex.zh: 球队进球时，全场观众突然欢呼起来并挥舞旗帜。

col: a burst of energy｜一股劲头
tip: burst 的过去式和过去分词都是 burst，不写 bursted。

senses.en: a plant grown in large quantities for food or other uses
the amount of a plant harvested at one time
to remove outer parts of an image or cut hair short

ex.en: The farmer checked his wheat crop after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后，农民查看了自己的小麦。

ex.en: Rising temperatures may reduce crop yields, threatening food security in regions that already experience water shortages.
ex.zh: 气温上升可能导致农作物减产，威胁本就缺水地区的粮食安全。

tip: crop既指庄稼也指收成；动词可指裁剪照片。

senses.en: to make someone admire or respect someone or something

senses.zh: 使铭记；使意识到重要性
senses.en: to make someone understand how important something is

ex.en: Her homemade bread impressed everyone at the family dinner.
ex.zh: 她自制的面包让家宴上的每个人都赞不绝口。

ex.en: Applicants can impress potential employers by explaining how their practical experience matches the requirements of the role.
ex.zh: 求职者可以说明自己的实践经验如何符合岗位要求，从而给潜在雇主留下好印象。

col: impress someone with｜以……给某人留下好印象
tip: impressed形容人的感受；impressive形容事物令人赞叹。

senses.en: To go somewhere and bring someone or something back.
To be sold for a particular amount of money.

ex.en: Could you fetch my jacket from the bedroom?
ex.zh: 你能去卧室把我的夹克拿来吗？

ex.en: Homes near reliable public transport often fetch higher prices because buyers value convenient access to employment.
ex.zh: 公共交通便利可靠的地段，住宅往往售价更高，因为买家重视通勤的便利性。

col: fetch someone from school｜去学校接某人
fetch a high price｜卖个高价
tip: fetch强调去后取回；bring只强调带来。

senses.en: the force that pulls objects toward the earth
the seriousness or importance of something

ex.en: Gravity makes apples fall to the ground.
ex.zh: 重力使苹果落到地上。

ex.en: Scientists study gravity to understand how planets move in space.
ex.zh: 科学家研究重力以了解行星如何在太空中运动。

col: gravity of the situation｜情况的严重性
tip: 注意 gravity 既指物理重力，也指事情的严重性，如 the gravity of the problem。

senses.en: A small item worn to show identity, membership, or achievement.

ex.en: She pinned her new badge onto her jacket.
ex.zh: 她把新徽章别在了夹克上。

ex.en: Requiring visitors to wear a visible badge can improve security in schools and other public buildings.
ex.zh: 要求访客佩戴醒目的身份徽章，有助于提高学校及其他公共建筑的安全性。

col: a badge of honour｜荣誉的象征
tip: 通常指佩戴的小徽章；奖牌一般用medal。

senses.en: To become ice or make something extremely cold and solid.
To stop something changing or being used temporarily.
To stop moving suddenly because of fear or surprise.

ex.en: Freeze the leftover soup and eat it next week.
ex.zh: 把剩下的汤冷冻起来，下周再喝。

ex.en: Governments may freeze public transport fares to reduce financial pressure on households during economic downturns.
ex.zh: 在经济低迷时期，政府可能会冻结公共交通票价，以减轻家庭的经济压力。

tip: 过去式froze，过去分词frozen。

senses.en: to exchange one thing for another
an act of exchanging something

ex.en: I swapped my sandwich for his apple at lunchtime.
ex.zh: 午餐时我用三明治换了他的苹果。

ex.en: Some students swap notes after class to help each other review for exams.
ex.zh: 一些学生课后交换笔记，互相帮助复习备考。

tip: swap 常用 swap A for B（用A换B）和 swap with sb（与某人交换）。

senses.en: The authority or place checking goods entering a country
Taxes charged on goods brought into a country
Traditional practices shared by a community or social group

ex.en: We opened our suitcases for inspection at customs.
ex.zh: 我们在海关打开行李箱接受检查。

ex.en: More efficient customs procedures can reduce delays at borders and support international trade without weakening security.
ex.zh: 更高效的海关程序可以减少边境延误，在不削弱安全保障的情况下促进国际贸易。

tip: 表示海关时保留词尾s；custom单数不表示海关。

senses.en: A shop or hospital department that prepares and supplies medicines.
The study and practice of preparing and supplying medicines.

ex.en: I collected my medicine from the pharmacy after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，我去药店取了药。

ex.en: A community pharmacy can improve access to healthcare by offering professional advice close to people's homes.
ex.zh: 社区药店能在居民家附近提供专业建议，使医疗保健服务更易获得。

tip: 药店可数，药剂学不可数；药剂师是pharmacist。

senses.en: A man who is in charge of a school.

ex.en: The headmaster welcomed new pupils at the school gate.
ex.zh: 男校长在校门口迎接新生。

ex.en: The headmaster introduced a mentoring programme to help younger pupils develop confidence and settle into school life.
ex.zh: 男校长推行了一项辅导计划，帮助低年级学生建立信心并适应学校生活。

tip: 指男性；英式headteacher不分性别，美式常用principal。

senses.en: kind and concerned about other people's needs
the work of looking after people who need help

ex.en: Our caring neighbour brought soup when I was ill.
ex.zh: 我生病时，体贴的邻居送来了汤。

ex.en: A caring school environment can improve children's confidence and encourage them to seek help when needed.
ex.zh: 充满关怀的学校环境能增强孩子的信心，并鼓励他们在需要时寻求帮助。

col: a caring environment｜充满关怀的环境
tip: caring指关心别人；careful指做事小心。

senses.en: the part of the body at the side of the waist

ex.en: She hurt her hip when she fell off her bike.
ex.zh: 她从自行车上摔下来时伤了髋部。

ex.en: Doctors advise older people to do simple exercises to keep their hips strong.
ex.zh: 医生建议老年人做简单的锻炼以保持髋部强壮。

tip: hip 指身体侧面髋部，日常也泛指臀部；注意与 heap（堆）拼写区分。

senses.en: Finding a total by adding equal groups together.
An increase in quantity, often through repeated reproduction.

ex.en: We practised multiplication by arranging buttons in equal rows.
ex.zh: 我们把纽扣排成等长的几行来练习乘法。

ex.en: A strong understanding of multiplication helps children develop the mathematical skills needed for science and financial literacy.
ex.zh: 扎实理解乘法有助于儿童发展学习科学和掌握财务知识所需的数学技能。

col: rapid multiplication｜快速繁殖；迅速增加
tip: 乘法用multiplication；乘以可用multiplied by。

senses.en: To find someone or something unpleasant or not enjoyable.
A feeling of not liking someone or something.

ex.en: I dislike waiting outside when it is raining.
ex.zh: 我不喜欢下雨时在外面等候。

ex.en: Some students dislike group assignments because they feel that individual contributions are not assessed fairly.
ex.zh: 一些学生不喜欢小组作业，因为他们觉得个人贡献没有得到公平评价。

col: dislike doing something｜不喜欢做某事
a strong dislike of｜对……的强烈反感
take a dislike to｜开始讨厌
tip: dislike后接名词或动名词：dislike waiting。

senses.en: an educational talk given to an audience, especially university students
to give an educational talk to an audience
to criticize someone at length about their behaviour

ex.en: I stayed after the lecture to ask a question.
ex.zh: 讲座结束后，我留下来问了一个问题。

ex.en: Universities should combine traditional lectures with practical activities that encourage students to apply their knowledge.
ex.zh: 大学应将传统授课与鼓励学生运用知识的实践活动结合起来。

col: lecture someone about｜就某事训斥某人
tip: lecture on讲授某主题；lecture someone可指训斥。

senses.en: Food placed inside a pie, sandwich, or similar item.
Material used to repair a hole in a tooth.
Making you feel full after eating.

ex.en: This pie has a warm apple and cinnamon filling.
ex.zh: 这个派里面是热乎乎的苹果肉桂馅。

ex.en: School lunches should offer filling meals that provide sufficient nutrients to support children's growth and concentration.
ex.zh: 学校午餐应提供有饱腹感且营养充足的饭菜，以支持儿童成长并帮助他们集中注意力。

tip: 作形容词表示食物顶饱，不表示人已经吃饱。

senses.en: a long journey by sea or in space
to travel a long way by ship or in space

ex.en: The old sailor told us stories about his first voyage across the sea.
ex.zh: 那位老水手给我们讲他第一次远航的故事。

ex.en: In 1831 a research ship began a five-year voyage to study plants and animals around the world.
ex.zh: 1831年，一艘考察船开始了为期五年的环球航行，研究世界各地的动植物。

col: make a voyage｜进行一次航行
a voyage of discovery｜探索之旅
tip: 多指海上或太空的长途航行；journey 用法更广，可指陆路旅行。

senses.en: To respect someone for their qualities or achievements
To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive

ex.en: I admire my sister for staying calm under pressure.
ex.zh: 我钦佩姐姐在压力下依然保持冷静。

ex.en: People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.
ex.zh: 人们常因成功运动员的毅力而钦佩他们，但坚持训练同样重要。

col: admire someone for something｜因某事钦佩某人
tip: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

senses.en: The physical state of someone or something
A requirement, or circumstances affecting life or activity
A medical problem affecting someone's health

ex.en: Despite its age, this bicycle is in excellent condition.
ex.zh: 这辆自行车虽然年头已久，但状况极佳。

ex.en: Improving working conditions can increase employee satisfaction and reduce the number of people leaving their jobs.
ex.zh: 改善工作条件可以提高员工满意度，并减少离职人数。

tip: 表状态通常不可数；表工作、生活环境常用复数。

senses.en: not joined, shared, or considered together
to divide things or move them apart

ex.en: We keep clean towels in a separate cupboard.
ex.zh: 我们把干净毛巾放在一个单独的柜子里。

ex.en: Local authorities should provide separate bins for recyclable materials to make household waste sorting easier.
ex.zh: 地方政府应为可回收材料提供专用垃圾桶，让家庭垃圾分类更方便。

tip: 形容词词尾读/ət/，动词词尾读/eɪt/。

senses.en: not mixed with other substances
complete and containing nothing of a different kind
concerned with theory rather than practical uses

ex.en: This soft scarf is made from pure wool.
ex.zh: 这条柔软的围巾是纯羊毛制成的。

ex.en: Investment in pure science can lead to unexpected discoveries with important practical applications decades later.
ex.zh: 对纯理论科学的投资可能带来意想不到的发现，并在几十年后产生重要的实际应用。

tip: pure既可指无杂质，也可加强语气，如pure luck。

senses.en: Open your mouth widely and breathe deeply from tiredness or boredom.
An involuntary wide opening of the mouth with a deep breath.

ex.en: I yawned twice while waiting for the kettle to boil.
ex.zh: 等水壶里的水烧开时，我打了两次哈欠。

ex.en: Students who regularly yawn during morning lessons may not be getting enough sleep at night.
ex.zh: 经常在早课上打哈欠的学生，可能夜间睡眠不足。

tip: 打哈欠可说yawn或give a yawn。

senses.en: a small pepper with a strong, hot taste
a spicy dish usually made with meat, beans, and tomatoes

ex.en: Add one chopped chilli if you like spicy food.
ex.zh: 如果你喜欢吃辣，就加一根切碎的辣椒。

ex.en: Farmers growing chilli peppers may need reliable irrigation systems as rising temperatures increase water demand.
ex.zh: 随着气温上升导致需水量增加，辣椒种植户可能需要可靠的灌溉系统。

tip: 英式拼写chilli，美式通常写chili。

senses.en: Fully grown and ready to eat or harvest
Ready for a particular action or development

ex.en: These ripe peaches smell wonderful and taste very sweet.
ex.zh: 这些熟桃子闻起来很香，吃起来很甜。

ex.en: With public support growing, the time is ripe for governments to invest more in renewable energy.
ex.zh: 随着公众支持度上升，政府加大可再生能源投资的时机已经成熟。

col: ripe for change｜变革时机成熟的
the time is ripe｜时机已经成熟
tip: 水果成熟用ripe；人心智成熟通常用mature。

senses.en: having a strong, unpleasant smell

ex.en: Please leave those stinky shoes outside the front door.
ex.zh: 请把那些臭鞋放在前门外。

ex.en: Residents often describe neglected rubbish bins as stinky, highlighting how poor waste collection affects daily life.
ex.zh: 居民常说无人清理的垃圾桶臭气熏天，这凸显了垃圾清运不力对日常生活的影响。

tip: 非正式用语；正式写作可用foul-smelling。

senses.en: Having a natural ability to do something very well.

ex.en: My talented cousin painted this beautiful picture of our garden.
ex.zh: 我那位有绘画天赋的表亲画了这幅漂亮的花园图。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for talented students to develop their abilities beyond the standard curriculum.
ex.zh: 学校应为有才华的学生提供机会，让他们在标准课程之外发展自己的能力。

col: a talented musician｜有天赋的音乐家
a talented artist｜有才华的艺术家
tip: talented强调天赋；skilled强调熟练技能。

senses.en: unhappy because someone has something you want

senses.zh: 因担心失去爱而吃醋的
senses.en: upset because someone you love shows interest in another person

ex.en: I felt jealous when my cousin got a bicycle.
ex.zh: 表弟得到一辆自行车时，我心里很嫉妒。

ex.en: Social media can make users jealous of others whose lives appear more successful or exciting.
ex.zh: 社交媒体可能让用户嫉妒那些生活看起来更成功或更精彩的人。

col: a jealous partner｜爱吃醋的伴侣
tip: 常用be jealous of；既可指嫉妒，也可指吃醋。

senses.en: an edible seed that grows underground inside a thin shell
a very small amount of money, expressed as peanuts

ex.en: She cracked the shell and ate the peanut inside.
ex.zh: 她剥开壳，吃掉了里面的花生米。

ex.en: Schools should consider peanut allergies when planning meals to ensure that all children can eat safely.
ex.zh: 学校安排膳食时应考虑花生过敏问题，确保所有儿童都能安全用餐。

col: work for peanuts｜为微薄报酬工作
tip: 表示“极少的钱”时用复数peanuts，属非正式用法。

senses.en: Relating to laws or the system that applies them
Allowed by the law

ex.en: We sought legal advice before signing the rental agreement.
ex.zh: 签订租赁协议前，我们征求了法律意见。

ex.en: Access to affordable legal services is essential for ensuring that disadvantaged citizens can defend their rights.
ex.zh: 让人们获得负担得起的法律服务，对保障弱势公民维护自身权利至关重要。

tip: legal可指“法律相关的”，不一定指“合法的”。

senses.en: A set of tools or equipment for a particular activity
A set of parts used to build something

ex.en: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
ex.zh: 我们在车里备有一个急救包。

ex.en: Schools should provide basic science kits so that all pupils can take part in practical experiments.
ex.zh: 学校应提供基础科学实验套件，让所有学生都能参与动手实验。

col: kit someone out｜给某人配齐装备
tip: kit指成套用品；kit sb out表示给某人配装备。

senses.en: At or to a greater distance.
Located at a greater distance.

ex.en: We walked farther along the beach before stopping for lunch.
ex.zh: 我们沿海滩又走了一段路才停下来吃午饭。

ex.en: As housing costs rise, many workers move farther from city centres and face longer daily commutes.
ex.zh: 随着住房成本上涨，许多上班族搬到离市中心更远的地方，每天通勤时间也随之增加。

tip: farther多指实际距离；进一步讨论用further。

senses.en: a woman who rents property or rooms to other people
a woman who owns or manages a pub

ex.en: Our landlady came round to fix the kitchen tap.
ex.zh: 我们的女房东过来修厨房水龙头。

ex.en: A responsible landlady should maintain safe housing conditions and respond promptly when tenants report serious problems.
ex.zh: 负责任的女房东应确保住房条件安全，并在租客报告严重问题时及时回应。

col: pay rent to the landlady｜向女房东交租
tip: landlady指女性；landlord可泛指房东。

senses.en: the point where something begins or comes from
the family or country a person comes from

ex.en: The origin of this old story is still unknown to us.
ex.zh: 这个老故事的起源对我们来说仍然未知。

ex.en: Scientists study the origin of life on Earth to understand how simple cells became complex.
ex.zh: 科学家研究地球上生命的起源，以了解简单细胞如何变得复杂。

col: the origin of life｜生命起源
tip: 注意拼写or-i-gin，中间没有a；词根ori-与“升起、开始”相关。

senses.en: A woman who welcomes and entertains guests.
A woman who welcomes customers and takes them to restaurant tables.

ex.en: Our hostess brought out fresh fruit after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐后，女主人端来了新鲜水果。

ex.en: A welcoming hostess can help international visitors feel comfortable and encourage meaningful conversations across cultures.
ex.zh: 热情的女主人能让国际访客感到自在，并促进有意义的跨文化交流。

col: a gracious hostess｜亲切周到的女主人
the perfect hostess｜无可挑剔的女主人
tip: hostess特指女性；host如今也可用于任何性别。

senses.en: relaxed and not easily upset or worried

ex.en: Our easy-going neighbour never complains when our dog barks.
ex.zh: 我们随和的邻居从不因我们的狗叫而抱怨。

ex.en: Although an easy-going management style can reduce workplace stress, clear expectations remain essential for maintaining productivity.
ex.zh: 虽然随和的管理风格能减轻职场压力，但明确的要求对保持生产力仍然至关重要。

tip: 形容性格随和、不易生气，不表示懒惰。

senses.en: in a smooth and easy way, especially speaking a language

ex.en: She speaks English and French fluently.
ex.zh: 她英语和法语说得很流利。

ex.en: He answered the questions fluently during the job interview.
ex.zh: 他在求职面试中对答如流。

tip: fluently常与speak, write等动词连用，描述语言能力。

senses.en: A sound that comes back to you because it hits a wall or surface.
To produce an echo, or to repeat what someone says.

ex.en: We shouted in the cave and heard our echo.
ex.zh: 我们在山洞里大喊，听到了回声。

ex.en: The teacher's voice echoed in the empty hall as she called the students to the meeting.
ex.zh: 老师叫学生去开会时，她的声音在空荡荡的大厅里回荡。

col: echo through the hall｜在大厅里回荡
echo someone's words｜重复某人的话
tip: 作名词时复数 echoes；作动词时过去式 echoed。

senses.en: Not speaking or choosing not to speak.
Making no sound or containing no noise.
Written in a word but not pronounced.

ex.en: He remained silent while his sister explained the problem.
ex.zh: 妹妹解释问题时，他一直没有说话。

ex.en: Employees may remain silent about workplace problems if they fear losing their jobs.
ex.zh: 如果员工担心失去工作，就可能对职场问题保持沉默。

tip: silent强调不出声；quiet也可表示声音很小。

senses.en: in a way that is not known or stated
for a reason that is not known

ex.en: Somehow, she managed to finish the project on time.
ex.zh: 不知怎么的，她设法按时完成了项目。

ex.en: The team somehow won the match despite losing three players to injury.
ex.zh: 尽管三名队员受伤，这支队伍还是不知怎么地赢了比赛。

tip: 常用于句首或句中，表示“不知怎么地”或“设法”；不用于疑问句。

senses.en: sports such as running, jumping and throwing
sports and physical games in general

ex.en: She joined the athletics club and now trains three times a week.
ex.zh: 她加入了田径俱乐部，现在每周训练三次。

ex.en: Athletics teaches young people that daily training matters more than talent alone.
ex.zh: 田径运动让年轻人明白，日常训练比单靠天赋更重要。

col: track and field athletics｜田径运动
tip: 英式常用 athletics 指田径；美式多用 track and field。

senses.en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: An enormous pumpkin filled the basket on our kitchen table.
ex.zh: 一个巨大的南瓜占满了厨房桌上的篮子。

ex.en: Rapid urban growth places enormous pressure on housing, transport networks, and other essential public services.
ex.zh: 城市的快速发展给住房、交通网络及其他基本公共服务带来巨大压力。

tip: 既可形容体积，也可形容压力、数量或影响很大。

senses.en: A plan or preparation for something that will happen.
The way objects are positioned or organised.
An agreement about how something will be done.

ex.en: We made arrangements for someone to feed the cat.
ex.zh: 我们安排了人来喂猫。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help parents balance professional responsibilities with the demands of family life.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排可以帮助父母兼顾工作职责与家庭生活的需要。

col: come to an arrangement｜达成协议
tip: 表示具体筹备常用复数：make arrangements for。

senses.en: A particular way of doing something, often requiring skill.
The skill someone shows when performing a particular activity.

ex.en: The coach showed me a better technique for swimming.
ex.zh: 教练向我示范了一种更好的游泳技巧。

ex.en: Teachers can use a range of assessment techniques to identify learning difficulties before students fall behind.
ex.zh: 教师可以运用多种评估方法，在学生落后之前发现他们的学习困难。

col: a technique for doing something｜做某事的方法
tip: technique重在具体方法；technology指科技。

senses.en: to put something down carefully or arrange it flat
to produce eggs from the body
not professionally trained in a subject or ordained in religion

ex.en: Please lay the clean towels on the bathroom shelf.
ex.zh: 请把干净毛巾放在浴室架子上。

ex.en: Investment in early childhood education can lay the foundations for a more skilled and adaptable workforce.
ex.zh: 投资幼儿教育可以为培养技能更强、适应力更高的劳动力奠定基础。

tip: 放置用lay–laid–laid；躺下用lie–lay–lain。

senses.en: caring and generous to other people

ex.en: The kind-hearted woman always helped her elderly neighbors.
ex.zh: 这位好心的女士总是帮助她年老的邻居。

ex.en: Kind-hearted volunteers spent their weekend cleaning up the local park.
ex.zh: 善良的志愿者们利用周末清理当地公园。

col: a kind-hearted person｜一个善良的人
tip: kind-hearted是复合形容词，用连字符连接。

senses.en: thin, light cloth used for medical dressing or clothing

ex.en: The nurse wrapped the cut with clean gauze.
ex.zh: 护士用干净的纱布包扎了伤口。

ex.en: In the school play, the stage was decorated with white gauze to look like clouds.
ex.zh: 在学校戏剧中，舞台用白色薄纱装饰，看起来像云朵。

col: a piece of gauze｜一块纱布
tip: 注意与“gaze”（凝视）拼写不同，gauze是布料或医用纱布。

senses.en: A remark expressing admiration or approval.
To tell someone that you admire something about them.

ex.en: Her compliment about my cooking made me smile.
ex.zh: 她对我厨艺的称赞让我笑了。

ex.en: Teachers who compliment students on specific improvements can strengthen motivation and encourage continued effort.
ex.zh: 教师若针对学生的具体进步给予表扬，就能增强学习动力，鼓励他们继续努力。

col: pay someone a compliment｜称赞某人
compliment someone on something｜称赞某人的某方面
tip: compliment是赞美；complement是补充、相辅相成。

senses.en: Money returned after a purchase or an overpayment.
To return money paid for something.

ex.en: The shop gave me a refund for the broken kettle.
ex.zh: 商店把坏水壶的货款退给了我。

ex.en: Airlines should offer passengers a full refund when flights are cancelled without reasonable alternatives.
ex.zh: 航班取消且没有合理的替代方案时，航空公司应向乘客提供全额退款。

tip: 名词重音在前；动词读/rɪˈfʌnd/，重音在后。

senses.en: A sport involving controlled movements that develop strength, balance, and flexibility.

ex.en: My sister practises gymnastics at the local sports centre.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在当地体育中心练体操。

ex.en: Including gymnastics in school programmes can help children develop coordination, physical confidence, and an interest in exercise.
ex.zh: 将体操纳入学校课程有助于儿童提高协调性、增强身体自信，并培养运动兴趣。

tip: 虽以-s结尾，表示运动时作单数：gymnastics is。

senses.en: The ability or authority to control people, events, or decisions.
Energy used to make machines and equipment work.
To supply energy that makes something work.

ex.en: The manager has the power to change our shifts.
ex.zh: 经理有权调整我们的班次。

ex.en: Solar panels can power rural schools while reducing their dependence on expensive and unreliable fuel supplies.
ex.zh: 太阳能板可以为乡村学校供电，同时减少其对昂贵且不稳定的燃料供应的依赖。

tip: 表示有权做某事用have the power to do。

senses.en: a traditional story, often about gods or heroes
an idea that many people believe but is false

ex.en: The myth of the hero spread across many ancient lands.
ex.zh: 这位英雄的神话传遍了古代许多地方。

ex.en: It is a common myth that we only use ten percent of our brains.
ex.zh: 一个常见的错误观念是我们只使用了大脑的百分之十。

tip: 注意区分 myth（神话/错误观念）与 mythos（神话体系），考试常考“常见误解”义。
